# opusdns_reports (Data Source)

Lists generated OpusDNS reports with optional server-side filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opusdns_reports" "completed_inventory" {
  report_types = ["domain_inventory"]
  statuses     = ["completed"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_after` (String) Filter reports created after this RFC3339 timestamp.
- `created_before` (String) Filter reports created before this RFC3339 timestamp.
- `report_types` (List of String) Filter by report type. Multiple values match any.
- `statuses` (List of String) Filter by report status. Multiple values match any.
- `trigger_type` (String) Filter by trigger type, such as `on_demand` or `scheduled`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for this data source.
- `reports` (Attributes List) Matching reports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reports))

<a id="nestedatt--reports"></a>
